comments.text: That's not a original new england clam bake. The original way is to dig a pit fill the bottom with big rocks, get a fire going on top of the rocks for at least 18hrs. Then on top the coals and rocks layer with seaweed/kelp on top, on of that you put down burlap bags and then on top of that you add the shellfish, lobsters, vegetables and fish then you put a another layer bulap bags of seaweed/kelp
